text:
Rina: dropped two mocks for the usage/billing list — 'dense-list' (very compact) and 'expanded-cards' (rows with visible actions). need quick UX checks before stakeholder review.
Tobias: link please
Rina: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/billing-list-iteration
Lena: dense-list is nice for scanning recent months, but the download and invoice notes are tucked into a 3-dots menu. worried support will get more "where's my invoice" tickets.
Marcus: expanded-cards surface Download / Pay / Dispute directly which reduces clicks but makes the page tall. mobile scrolling concern.
Kei: accessibility: in dense-list the token badge ("12k") is announced as "one two k" by voiceover. we should change display to "12,000 tokens" or provide aria-label overrides.
Rina: good catch. also thinking about whether to surface a small overdue chip on the left to call attention to unpaid invoices.
Tobias: maybe show an inline small "Pay now" for overdue only, otherwise keep actions in overflow. reduces accidental payments.
Lena: +1 for overdue inline. Also, can we add a micro-sparkline next to the amount in dense mode? preserves trend context without expanding.
Marcus: sparklines are fine but need accessible text: e.g., aria-label="Traffic last 30 days: rising" and role="img". we should ensure colorblind-safe palette.
Kei: another a11y nit: focus ring missing on the chevron toggle in expanded-cards. keyboard users can't reliably open row details. also tabindex order jumps from checkbox to the dropdown, skipping the expand.
ui-bot: Rina uploaded updated mocks (dense-list-v2, expanded-cards-v3)
Rina: addressed voiceover labels (aria-label on token amount), added overdue inline Pay for >30d, added optional sparkline + aria-label, fixed focus states on chevrons. trimmed expand animation to 110ms for mobile.
Tobias: looks much better. one tiny UX thought: when Pay is inline, add a confirmation micro-modal to prevent accidental payments (primary Confirm, secondary Cancel).
Lena: metrics proposal: run a short pilot 2 weeks, 25% users see dense-list+sparkline, 25% see expanded-cards with inline overdue pay, rest see control. track: invoice downloads, pay completions, support ticket mentions of "invoice", average rows expanded.
Marcus: can we also capture keyboard-only users' interactions? maybe a custom event when Enter toggles rows and when focus lands on Pay.
Kei: final a11y check: contrast of overdue chip in dark theme is 3.9:1. need >=4.5:1. Rina can you bump color and keep visual weight?
Rina: will update and re-upload before the review. adding this pilot plan to tomorrow's sync (5m) and will post final mocks. any other blockers?
Tobias: none from engineering side.
Lena: nothing else.
Rina: thanks team :thumbsup:
